metadata.title: Tripura shows solidarity with Manipur: Demanding Justice for Kuki Women | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: In a powerful display of unity and support, tribal communities in Tripura organized a significant silent torch march in Agartala, standing in solidarity with the people of Manipur. Alongside this, prominent writers, activists, and tribal leaders jointly issued an appeal to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, urging him to address the situation in Manipur. The appeal highlighted the urgent need for justice for the Kuki women who were subjected to heinous acts of violence, being paraded naked and gang-raped by a mob. The call for action aims to draw attention to the atrocities in Manipur and advocate for accountability and measures to ensure the safety and well-being of vulnerable communities.
